title: Observability and cold start
brief: Parse an engine event log into queue, TTFT, and ITL histograms, read a quantile back from the buckets, write alerts that do not flap, and model the time to ready of a cold start.
hints: A bucket's le is less than or equal. Count a sample into the first bucket whose bound is at least the sample, then add the counts from the left so each bucket includes all the smaller ones.

histogram_quantile finds the first bucket whose cumulative count reaches q times the total, then interpolates between that bucket's lower and upper bound by how far into its own samples the rank falls.

The alert has three states: idle, pending since some time, and firing. Pending needs the condition to hold for for_s. Firing needs the condition to stay false for keep_firing_for_s before it resolves.
Streaming reads chunk k+1 while it copies chunk k. For n equal chunks the time is n times the slower stage plus one chunk of the faster stage.
